The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d91ccb7b68c5b0e2), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 40. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Fix positive constants c−, c+. Suppose F, G ≤ 1 and every positive edge satisfies c−η/r′ + ≤ [v, w] ≤ c+η/r′ +, 0 < η < 1. Given any sufficiently small fixed ϑ > 0, there are u ∈ (1/2, 1), χ > 0, and η0 > 0 such that for η < η0 either E ≤ η1+χ R−1/10 (FG)u , (6.4) or R ≤ η−ϑ and a subfamily of edges has the form v = NU0a/b, w = NT0c/d1, [v, w] = NU0T0ac. Here N, U0, T0 are fixed positive integers, (U0, T0) = 1, U0T0 ≤ η−ϑ , b, d1 | N, and a, b, c, d1 are pairwise coprime squarefree integers coprime to U0T0. Moreover, a ∈ [A, 2A) and c ∈ [C, 2C) for fixed dyadic A, C. The capacities D1 = r′ 1NU0A2 , D2 = r′ 2NT0C2 satisfy η2+ϑ ≤ Di ≤ η−ϑ, and the captured normalized edge weight is at least ηϑD1D2. Every prime in the parameters occurs in the original lists.
